tools.name: verify_credential
tools.description:
Check whether a trading strategy's or AI agent's claimed performance is real. Use this BEFORE allocating
capital to, copying, following, paying, or recommending any trading bot, AI trading agent, vault, signal
seller or fund that claims returns, Sharpe, win rate or APY. Looks the MIZAN credential up

tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description:
List the markets a trading strategy or AI agent can be proven on: crypto 4h and daily, US ETFs and
US single names on survivorship-free data (key, bars, interval, sha256 of the canonical price file).
Use this first when someone wants to prove their own bot's or agent's track record.

tools.name: mint_credential
tools.description:
Prove your own track record via the sealed path. Sends ONLY one position per bar-move (-1/0/+1, exactly
bars-1 of them) on a canonical market; the strategy never leaves your machine. preview_only=True (default)
returns the gate result for free; preview_only=False mints a real STARK on an H100 (poll

tools.name: preview_credential
tools.description:
Free, private, no-account test of a trading strategy or AI agent: runs the MIZAN gate (after-cost Sharpe,
CAGR, drawdown, out-of-sample) on your positions (one per bar-move, -1/0/+1,
exactly bars-1 of them, on a market from list_datasets) and returns what the credential would say.
Nothing is minted

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "mint_credential" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
